faq.q: Does a captured bill post to the books by itself?
faq.a: No. Capture makes a draft bill or expense claim. You open it, check it and submit it.

faq.q: What if the same bill is sent in twice?
faq.a: Capture flags it as a possible duplicate, and you have to answer before a draft is made.

faq.q: Can I send a bill without opening the app?
faq.a: Yes. Forward the email to your capture address, or send the file in your team's chat platform.
